name: feature.email.nodes
description: Email feature node pack — read/render nodes over the ctx.features.email surface, plus submit-for-review (a side effect: it queues the campaign's send approval; it never approves or sends). list-templates reads an org's templates; render interpolates a template for a contact ({{contact.*}}).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Email: List Templates
nodes.description: Lists an org's email templates over ctx.features.email. Tenant-guarded.

nodes.label: Email: Get Template
nodes.description: Fetches one email template by id over ctx.features.email.getTemplate. Inputs: { orgId, templateId }. Output: { template }. Tenant-guarded; not_found when absent.

nodes.label: Email: Render
nodes.description: Renders a template's subject + body for a contact ({{contact.name|email|company}}) over ctx.features.email.

nodes.label: Email: Submit for Review
nodes.description: Submits a draft email campaign for send review over ctx.features.email.submitForReview (one approval row per campaign; a resubmit repins it). Inputs: { orgId, campaignId }. Output: { campaignId, status, approvalId, templateVersion }. A human approves in the Approvals inbox; this node can never approve or send.
